
DESCRIPTION
Disable continuous integration

USAGE
  one ci disable [project] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one ci disable web
  one ci disable --yes

TIPS
Removes generated continuous-integration configuration for one project, or every project when no project is provided. Interactive terminals ask for confirmation; non-interactive calls require --yes.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  -y, --yes                Confirm removal without prompting

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  -p, --project <value>    Select a project by name or workspace-relative path (legacy/automation)
